messages:
Alex: Quick pre-canary check — change window opens in ~20m. Canary target: service-inference v2.3.1. @Maya you own migration pin, @Sam will you watch SLOs?
Maya: Confirmed. Schema migration pin applied: `migration_2026_03_20_v1` — no rolling migrations planned.
DeployBot: deploy triggered: `deploy --env=canary --image=service-inference:v2.3.1 --pin=migration_2026_03_20_v1` — started. ETA ~2m. :rocket:
Priya: Release notes uploaded to /releases/2026-03-20-canary. QA smoke checklist is at docs/smoke-checks/canary.md.
Sam: I'll watch latency SLO and error budget. Pager on, dashboard link: https://observ.console/redwood/slo/inference (monitoring set).
Marcus: Canary cutoff criteria: 95th latency < 220ms and error rate < 0.5% sustained for 10m. Any breach -> manual rollback (callout to oncall).
Maya: Pin details: db migration was synchronous, no backfill tasks. Data-platform approved: :white_check_mark: @Priya please note in changelog.
Alex: Smoke steps (run in order):
```
# health check
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_KEY" https://canary.api.redwood/v1/health
# simple generation smoke
python infra/tests/smoke_inference.py --endpoint https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate --prompt "hello"
```
Marcus: I'll ramp traffic to 10qps after a 3m stable window, then to 50qps if metrics look healthy.
DeployBot: Canary health checks: all OK. KV cache warmups 100%. No container restarts detected.
Priya: Noting: tagging release in changelog as `v2.3.1-canary` and filling rollback rationale template.
Alex: Rollback command if needed:
```
deploy --env=canary --rollback-to service-inference:v2.3.0
```
Maya: One small warning — a transient flake in embeddings smoke (0.5% failure). Not yet trend-worthy, watching closely.
Sam: Raising alert sensitivity: alert on >0.3% error increase over 5m and auto-escalate to paging.
Alex: OK — we'll hold canary for 30m unless we get green to cutover. Keep notes and any anomalies in this thread. :thumbsup:
